newsitem.title: USA: U.S.A. Growth extends warrants expiration.
newsitem.headline: U.S.A. Growth extends warrants expiration.

text.p: U.S.A. Growth Inc said Monday it extended the expiration dates of its class A and class B warrants to December 31, 1997.
The extension is related to U.S.A. Growth's merger with internet casino gaming company World Wide Web Casinos to form a new company, Newco.
U.S.A. Growth shareholders will own about six percent of the outstanding shares of the new entity and World Wide shareholders the remaining 94 percent after the merger, the company said on July 14.
U.S.A. Growth's shares closed unchanged at 7/16 Monday.
